title: Wireframing & Prototyping
description: Translate ideas into testable low- and mid-fidelity designs. Tests sketching, interactive prototyping, and complex interaction modelling.

seo.overviewBody: Prototypes bring product concepts to life before writing code. Hiring managers evaluate UI/UX designers on sketching low-fidelity wireframes, translating user flows into high-fidelity interactive Figma prototypes, component state variants, and realistic micro-interactions.

deliverables.title: 1. Interactive Figma Prototype Link
deliverables.desc: Fully linked Figma prototype featuring clickable user flows, component state hover/active variants, and smooth transitions.

deliverables.title: 2. Low-to-High Fidelity Wireframe Evolution Deck
deliverables.desc: Design deck documenting layout iterations from initial paper sketches to finalized UI wireframes.

deliverables.title: 3. Prototype User Flow Documentation
deliverables.desc: Diagram mapping primary user task pathways, edge cases, and modal overlay behaviors.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a wireframe and a prototype?
faqs.answer: Wireframes are static, low-fidelity structural blueprints focused on layout and content hierarchy. Prototypes are interactive, high-fidelity simulations that demonstrate user interactions and dynamic behavior.

faqs.question: When should designers transition from low-fi to high-fi wireframes?
faqs.answer: Transition to high-fidelity UI only after core layout, information hierarchy, and user task flows are validated on low-fidelity wireframes.

faqs.question: How do you structure overlay interactions in Figma prototypes?
faqs.answer: Use Figma's 'Open Overlay' trigger set to 'Center' or 'Manual' positioning, with 'Close when clicking outside' enabled for clean modal testing.
